title: Anu Disingkirkeun ku Uji Cai
intro: Dina catetan kitab suci kuno, aya hiji tokoh anu matak pikaresepeun anu caritana lain dimimitian ku mujijat anu dramatis atanapi wahyu anu ngaguruh, tapi ku cocoba iman anu saderhana tapi jero. Hiji bangsa nangtung di simpang jalan, milarian pituduh ilahi pikeun kapamingpinan. Anu lumangsung nyaéta cocoba anu pinter pisan anu bakal ngungkabkeun saha jalma anu percaya sajati di antara aranjeunna. Naha anjeun tiasa ngabongkar misteri ieu tina petunjuk anu ditinggalkeun?
clues: Abdi asalna ti garis keturunan anu dipikareueus ku jalma-jalma, sareng Allah milih abdi pikeun tujuan suci anu teu kahartos ku aranjeunna.
Awak kuring mawa ciri has anu teu aya dina diri batur, anu ngajadikeun kuring béda ti jalma-jalma séjén.
Nalika walungan dinyatakeun minangka ujian, kalolobaanana malik ka tukang—tapi kuring terus maju, didorong ku iman anu teu goyah kana jangji Allah.
Kuring diparentahkeun ulah nginum tina cai anu dilarang, tapi aya hiji tetes anu kaluar tina biwir kuring—dosa anu ngaganggu haté kuring salamina.
Allah geus nangtukeun kuring kudu nepungan hiji pangangon ngora anu hiji mangsa bakal jadi legenda lantaran maehan musuh anu perkasa.
Nalika pasukan-pasukan bentrok, kuring teu gugur ku leungeun musuh, tapi ku kaputusan ilahi salaku hukuman kusabab teu nurut kuring di walungan.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
